inventory: Year 1 WBS. Geothermal Permitting Innovation Collaborative sheet of the Proposed Permitting Funding Request FY27.

streams.name: Program operations
streams.note: Charter, membership, public site, and measurement.

streams.name: Federal geothermal capacity
streams.note: Handbooks, categorical exclusions, rulemaking analysis, and field training, with BLM as design partner.

streams.name: Permitting Support Team
streams.note: Host-agency placements. Signed host commitments are required.

streams.name: State geothermal capacity
streams.note: Navigation assistance, regulatory programs, partner-state selection, and staff training.

streams.name: Tribal geothermal capacity
streams.note: Participation support and convening. Coordination only. Consultation stays with the responsible agency.

streams.name: Intergovernmental Geothermal Accelerator
streams.note: Cohorts, peer learning, technical assistance, and exchange sessions for intergovernmental geothermal permitting, plus Energy Determinants of Health pathway work.

streams.name: Permitting Innovation Exchange
streams.note: Hackathons, shark tanks, and challenge events that put industry, government, and applicants on the same permitting problems.

streams.name: Training and technical assistance
streams.note: Curriculum, federal and Tribal cohorts, applicant readiness, and published templates.

streams.name: Evidence and diffusion
streams.note: Practitioner participation, lab synthesis, and translation into briefs and sessions.

streams.name: Applied permitting research
streams.note: Multi-perspective case studies at PNNL, interviews, and observed durations for the GPCP rule set.

streams.name: Fellowship support
streams.note: Applied Permitting Research Fellow and Energy Determinants Fellow.

packages.name: Charter and operating model
packages.milestone: Charter adopted covering purpose, membership, participation terms and the relationship to GPCP, SEPI and existing lab research.

packages.name: Membership map and convening cadence
packages.milestone: Participating federal, state, Tribal and applicant organizations identified, with the recurring cadence attached to the existing Nevada monthly interagency call.

packages.name: Digital presence and materials
packages.milestone: Public-facing site, session materials and a shared workspace for participants, Section 508 conformant.

packages.name: Participation and outcome measurement
packages.milestone: Participation, backlog contribution, cohort completion and technical assistance reach measured, each traced to the capability it advances.

packages.name: Environmental review and categorical exclusion substantiation
packages.milestone: Substantiation analysis supporting proposed categorical exclusions for geothermal activities, prepared to the standard a Federal Register notice requires, scoped with BLM as design partner and accepted by BLM as usable in a proposal it decides whether to make.

packages.name: Geothermal handbook development
packages.milestone: Draft handbooks for geothermal leasing, exploration, well field development, utilization and unitization brought to final form against requirements set by BLM as design partner, accepted by BLM for adoption, published, and reusable in state model framework work at 4.2.

packages.name: Rulemaking technical analysis
packages.milestone: Technical analysis and options on administrative burden and clarity in updated geothermal regulations, responding to questions BLM poses as design partner. Analysis and options; BLM drafts regulatory text.

packages.name: Training module updates
packages.milestone: Existing geothermal leasing, exploration, well field development and utilization training modules updated to align with the final handbooks, accepted by BLM as design partner for use with its field staff, and published as open modules usable by state regulators and the training cohorts at 8.2.

packages.name: Team design and appointment vehicles
packages.performer: Intergovernmental fellow with Program, OGC and HR
packages.milestone: Team model settled: which partner agencies host, what fellows and scholars do while placed there, which appointment vehicle applies to each role, what the host agency provides, and draft position descriptions.

packages.name: Host agency commitments
packages.milestone: Written commitments from host agencies covering placement, supervision, workspace and return arrangements. Signed host commitments are required.

packages.name: Year 2 rollout plan
packages.milestone: Cohort size, recruitment timeline, placement sequence and a costed Year 2 rollout.

packages.name: Federal permitting navigation assistance
packages.performer: NLR, LBNL and PNNL with NASEO, Intergovernmental fellow coordinates
packages.milestone: Existing federal products delivered and translated for states: RAPID, PermitAI and NEPATEC, LBNL timelines work and GPCP. Completes the federal portions of state permitting roadmaps for requesting states.

packages.name: State regulatory program and policy development
packages.performer: NASEO and NLR with OG state partnership lead
packages.milestone: Direct support to states standing up or adapting geothermal regulatory programs, including model regulatory frameworks, ownership and regulatory alignment analysis, lead regulatory agency designation, and the UIC Class V primacy pathway with the Groundwater Protection Council.

packages.name: State convening, participation and partner state selection
packages.performer: NASEO with OG state partnership lead
packages.milestone: Convening of states with geothermal potential delivered, with travel and participation costs covered for state staff across all Collaborative sessions. Acceptance is a shortlist of partner states that have secured Governor-level commitment to advance geothermal through policy, permitting, procurement and partnership, following the NASEO first movers model.

packages.name: State-specific technical analyses
packages.milestone: Analyses scoped to what a partner state will act on: novel technology evaluation, interconnection, surface and water resource protection including thermal features, and incentive design.

packages.name: State regulatory staff training
packages.milestone: Federal permitting and regulatory training delivered to state regulatory and energy office staff, reusing the Collaborative curriculum.

packages.name: Tribal participation support
packages.milestone: Travel and participation costs covered for Tribal environmental and cultural staff. Coordination only. Consultation authority remains with the responsible federal agency.

packages.name: Tribal Government convening
packages.performer: Contractor with Intergovernmental fellow and Office of Indian Energy
packages.milestone: Two sessions co-designed with participating Tribal Governments and Tribal organizations around their stated geothermal and permitting priorities, held alongside existing venues such as the Indian Country Energy and Infrastructure Working Group or BIA regional Federal Partners meetings. Coordination only. Consultation stays with the responsible federal agency.

packages.name: Recurring permitting exchange sessions
packages.milestone: At least eight sessions held with documented participation from BLM, one state agency and one Tribal-facing office.

packages.name: Annual in-person exchange
packages.milestone: One multi-day exchange delivered, bringing federal, state, Tribal and applicant participants into the same room.

packages.name: Regional sessions
packages.milestone: Two regional sessions held in geothermal-active states, at least one hosted by a BLM state or district office.

packages.name: Local and non-federal participation support
packages.milestone: Travel and participation costs covered for local government, applicant and other non-federal participants whose organizations cannot fund attendance. State participation sits in 4.3 and Tribal participation in 5.1.

packages.name: Energy determinants pathway map and indicator inventory
packages.milestone: Four pathways characterized under one structure: affordability and thermal conditions, reliability for medically vulnerable populations, exposures from production and heating technologies, and energy-sector employment and occupational conditions. Each entry names the energy condition, the affected population or workforce, the downstream mechanism, an existing indicator held by another agency, and whether the link is established or plausible and unverified. Pathways ranked by evidentiary maturity.

packages.name: Energy determinants interagency working group
packages.milestone: At least six sessions with documented participation from HHS, the Indian Health Service, VA and DOL. Each session tests one pathway entry against the agency holding the indicator and produces either confirmation that the measure can be used as identified or a statement of what would be required. No pathway advances to Year 2 on the fellow's characterization alone.

packages.name: Energy determinants convening
packages.milestone: One convening with community, Tribal, health-agency and workforce participation, structured around the ranked pathways, with travel support for participants whose organizations cannot fund attendance.

packages.name: Challenge development and problem statements
packages.milestone: Problem statements drawn from GPCP requirements and the pilot backlog, with judging criteria and data access arrangements settled.

packages.name: Three hackathon events
packages.milestone: Three events delivered, with participation from outside DOE, including at least one non-federal team and one event co-hosted with a state agency.

packages.name: Output triage and technical assessment
packages.milestone: Every output assessed and dispositioned. Prototypes enter the backlog as candidate requirements.

packages.name: Curriculum development
packages.milestone: Curriculum covering permitting project management and applied AI for permitting staff, reviewed by practitioners.

packages.name: Federal and Tribal training cohorts
packages.milestone: Cohorts completed for federal permitting staff and for Tribal environmental offices. Graduates form the recruitment pool for GPCP pilot onboarding.

packages.name: Applicant pre-application readiness support
packages.milestone: Direct assistance to at least eight project proponents, prioritizing developers without in-house permitting counsel. Assistance is readiness support.

packages.name: Permitting guidance materials and templates
packages.milestone: Checklists, submission templates and process guidance published, cross-referenced to RAPID and BLM guidance.

packages.name: Practitioner participation in applied research
packages.performer: Contractor with Applied Permitting Research fellow
packages.milestone: Collaborative membership supplies the sampling frame for the applied research program. Practitioners identified, recruited and scheduled for interviews and case reconstruction, with at least two sessions in which practitioners react to draft findings before they are finalized.

packages.name: Evidence synthesis from lab research
packages.performer: Contractor with Applied Permitting Research fellow
packages.milestone: Findings from LBNL timelines and PNNL applied permitting research synthesized into a form usable by the GPCP dependency rule set and instrumentation.

packages.name: Applied research translation and diffusion
packages.performer: Contractor with Applied Permitting Research fellow
packages.milestone: Case research turned into practitioner briefs, training cases and cross-domain lessons, and worked into Collaborative sessions.

packages.name: Case selection, methods and records
packages.performer: PNNL with Applied Permitting Research fellow
packages.milestone: Case selection logic, common case structure, protocols and records assembled, with the Paperwork Reduction Act question resolved before any non-federal respondent is approached.

packages.name: Four to six multi-perspective case studies
packages.milestone: Each case reconstructs the project chronology from initial development activity through agency reviews and decisions, across applicant, BLM, state, wildlife, cultural resource, Tribal-facing and cooperating agency perspectives. One or two cases carry the existing surface thermal features work.

packages.name: Permitting official and applicant interviews and field visits
packages.performer: PNNL with Applied Permitting Research fellow
packages.milestone: What information was requested and when it became available, where handoffs occurred, what caused rework or waiting, which dependencies were understood in advance, and where written process differed from actual practice.

packages.name: Cross-case comparative analysis
packages.milestone: Recurring patterns identified across cases, with observed durations that replace stated assumptions in the GPCP rule set.

packages.name: Evidence products and research meeting
packages.performer: PNNL, Applied Permitting Research fellow convenes
packages.milestone: Findings delivered in a form GPCP requirements, the SEPI data model, curriculum and state technical assistance can use. Includes venue, materials and participant travel for the annual OG permitting research meeting; agenda and synthesis are fellow work.

packages.name: Applied Permitting Research Fellow
packages.milestone: Research agenda, case selection, practitioner interviews, cross-lab inventory and the annual research meeting, transfer of findings into requirements.

packages.name: Energy Determinants Fellow
packages.milestone: Energy affordability and thermal conditions, reliability for medically vulnerable populations, exposures from production and heating technologies, and energy-sector employment and occupational conditions. Workforce is treated as a mediated pathway.
